explanation: Samuel Morse and Alfred Vail gave the shortest patterns to the commonest English letters, so E is a single dot and T a single dash.

claims.text: Morse code represents letters as sequences of dots and dashes.
Braille uses raised dots, semaphore uses flag positions and binary code uses 0s and 1s, not dots and dashes.
Samuel Morse and Alfred Vail gave the shortest codes to the most common letters in English.
In Morse code, E is a single dot and T is a single dash.
